title: Coinbase Surges on Blockbuster Q4 Earnings: ETFs to Buy
description: Coinbase (COIN) posted its first quarterly profit in two years, beating on earnings and revenues estimates. Trading volume also surged on a new wave of optimism about digital assets, marking a turning point for the largest U.S. cryptocurrency exchange.

title: Coinbase Falls Despite Q1 Earnings Beat: ETFs in Focus
description: Coinbase Global (COIN) surpassed estimates on both earnings and revenues, benefiting from the wave of revival in digital coin trading largely due to the launch of a series of new bitcoin ETFs in January.
